ModMetaData.name: Mod Sync
ModMetaData.author: fnielson
ModMetaData.description:
Sync your active mods, load order and mod settings from a host's game to yours.
WITH THE MULTIPLAYER MOD
Host: nothing to do. Host your Multiplayer game as usual; Mod Sync starts hosting with it.
Players: join the game as usual. If your mods already match the host's, you go straight in and never see Mod Sync. If they don't, Multiplayer reports the mismatch and Mod Sync opens with the server filled in, showing what will change. Click Sync (or "Apply mod list & settings" if nothing needs downloading), wait for it to finish, then click "Restart and rejoin". The game restarts with the host's mods and joins the server again.
If the host's mods all come from the Workshop, this works without reaching the host's Mod Sync, so the host doesn't need to open any extra ports.
WITHOUT MULTIPLAYER
Host: click "Mod Sync" on the main menu, then "Start hosting". Players need your address, plus TCP port 28150 forwarded if they're outside your network.
Players: click "Mod Sync" on the main menu, enter the host's address, click Check to see what would change, then Sync, then "Restart now".
WHAT GETS SYNCED
Missing Workshop mods are subscribed through Steam. The host's load order and mod settings are copied. Mods that only exist on the host's computer are downloaded straight from the host, but only if you tick "I trust and know the host personally": they can contain any code, so only do that for hosts you trust.
